items.definition: Bir cümlenin anlamını koruyan yeniden ifadesini seçmeye dayanan sekiz soru.

questions.prompt: Had the company invested more in research, it would not have lost its market share.
options: The company did not lose its market share because it invested more in research.
If the company invests more in research, it will not lose its market share.
The company lost its market share because it did not invest enough in research.
The company invested more in research and therefore lost its market share.
The company lost its market share although it invested heavily in research.
questions.explanationTR: Üçüncü tip koşul: şirket yeterince yatırım yapmadı, bu yüzden pazar payını kaybetti: (C). (A) pazar payı kaybının olmadığını söyler. (B) gerçek koşula ve geleceğe çevirir. (D) yatırımı kayıp nedeni yapar. (E) yoğun yatırım yaptığını söyler.

questions.prompt: No sooner had the law been passed than protests began.
options: Protests began as soon as the law was passed.
Protests began before the law was passed.
The law was passed as soon as protests began.
Protests began long after the law was passed.
Protests were passed as soon as the law began.
questions.explanationTR: «No sooner ... than» art arda gerçekleşen iki olayı anlatır: yasa kabul edilir edilmez protestolar başladı: (A). (B) sırayı tersine çevirir. (C) protestoları yasadan önceye alır. (D) zamanı «çok sonra»ya çevirir. (E) anlamsız bir özne kullanır.

questions.prompt: Not all the tickets have been sold.
options: None of the tickets have been sold.
All of the tickets have been sold.
Not one ticket remains unsold.
Some of the tickets have not been sold.
All of the tickets remain unsold.
questions.explanationTR: «Not all» kısmi olumsuzdur: bazı biletler satılmadı: (D). (A) hiçbirinin satılmadığını söyler. (B) hepsinin satıldığını söyler. (C) hiçbirinin satılmadan kalmadığını söyler. (E) hepsinin satılmadan kaldığını söyler.

questions.prompt: The report was neither accurate nor complete.
options: The report was inaccurate and incomplete.
The report was either accurate or complete.
The report was accurate but incomplete.
The report was complete but inaccurate.
The report was both accurate and complete.
questions.explanationTR: «Neither ... nor» iki niteliği de olumsuzlar: rapor hem yanlıştı hem eksikti: (A). (B) ve (C) ile (D) niteliklerden birini olumlu yapar. (E) ikisini de olumlu yapar.

questions.prompt: Little did they realise how serious the situation was.
options: They realised at once how serious the situation was.
They realised how little the situation mattered.
The situation was not serious, so they did not realise it.
They realised that the situation was somewhat serious.
They did not realise how serious the situation was.
questions.explanationTR: «Little did they realise» olumsuz anlamlıdır: durumun ciddiyetini fark etmediler: (E). (A) hemen fark ettiklerini söyler. (B) önemsiz olduğunu fark ettiklerini söyler. (C) durumun ciddi olmadığını söyler. (D) ciddiyetin kısmen fark edildiğini söyler.

questions.prompt: Unlike her predecessor, the new director welcomes criticism.
options: The new director welcomes criticism, just as her predecessor did.
The new director welcomes criticism, whereas her predecessor did not.
The new director does not welcome criticism, unlike her predecessor.
Her predecessor welcomed criticism, whereas the new director does not.
The new director welcomes criticism because her predecessor did.
questions.explanationTR: «Unlike» zıtlık kurar: yeni müdür eleştiriyi karşılar, selefi karşılamazdı: (B). (A) benzerlik kurar. (C) ve (D) yeni müdürün tutumunu tersine çevirir. (E) nedeni selefin tutumu yapar.

questions.prompt: The trial was postponed owing to the illness of the judge.
options: The trial was postponed because the judge was ill.
The judge was ill because the trial was postponed.
The trial was postponed although the judge was ill.
The trial was postponed after the judge recovered.
The trial took place despite the judge's illness.
questions.explanationTR: «Owing to» neden bildirir: yargıç hasta olduğu için duruşma ertelendi: (A). (B) neden ile sonucu tersine çevirir. (C) nedeni karşıtlığa çevirir. (D) ertelemeyi iyileşmeden sonraya taşır. (E) duruşmanın yapıldığını söyler.

questions.prompt: By the time the ambulance arrived, the patient had already recovered.
options: The patient recovered after the ambulance arrived.
The ambulance arrived before the patient recovered.
The patient had recovered before the ambulance arrived.
The patient recovered because the ambulance arrived.
The patient had not recovered when the ambulance arrived.
questions.explanationTR: «By the time ... had already recovered» iyileşmenin varıştan önce olduğunu söyler: (C). (A) sırayı tersine çevirir. (B) varışı iyileşmeden önceye alır. (D) iyileşmeyi ambulansın varışına bağlar. (E) iyileşmediğini söyler.
